name: vaccin-delivery
description: Vaccinatie-levering exam monorepo — vaccine ordering and delivery platform

scripts.prepare: node --input-type=module -e "try { const { default: husky } = await import('husky'); husky(); } catch { /* omit=dev / Docker stages without husky */ }"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,pwa -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:pwa"
scripts.generate:graphql: npm run generate:schema && npm run generate:types
scripts.build:pwa: npm run generate:graphql && npm run build --workspace=@vaccin-delivery/pwa
scripts.typecheck:pwa: npm run generate:graphql && npm run typecheck --workspace=@vaccin-delivery/pwa
scripts.test:e2e:api: npm run test:e2e --workspace=@vaccin-delivery/api && npm run test:e2e:security --workspace=@vaccin-delivery/api
scripts.prepush:check: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:pwa && npm run test:api && npm run test:pwa
